_doc: Gold standard for concept SENSE extraction. Ground truth is Shoghi Effendi's own usage: his English rendering is authoritative interpretation, so where he fixes a sense we do not have to invent one. Each fixture names the DISTINCT senses a symbol carries — never a single 'correct' answer, because symbolic works mean several things at once. `instantiations` are phrasings that belong to a listed sense rather than being senses of their own; they exist to measure the inflation defect found 2026-08-25, where per-passage glosses were being stored as if they were separate senses.
_scoring: recall = distinct senses found / senses expected. distinctness = 1 - (recorded entries that collapse onto an already-covered sense / total recorded). A high sense COUNT with low distinctness is the failure this file was built to expose.

senses.gloss: that which veils or obscures recognition of the Manifestation — trials, crises, opposition
senses.basis: Kitáb-i-Íqán treats the clouds as the veils that prevent recognition

senses.gloss: the advent itself — the coming of the Lord in majesty, the overshadowing of His appearance
senses.basis: the Gospel 'coming in the clouds of heaven', reinterpreted in the Íqán

senses.gloss: the veils of human learning and ecclesiastical authority that darken the horizon
senses.basis: God Passes By on the darkening horizon of Christian ecclesiasticism

senses.gloss: the abrogation of former laws and ordinances
senses.basis: Íqán: the clouds are the annulment of laws

instantiations: The clouds represent obscurity or opposition that enveloped the Manifestation in Baghdád.
the darkening horizon of Christian ecclesiasticism
represent trials or crises that obscure the Faith

senses.gloss: the Manifestation of God Himself, whose Revelation illumines the world as the sun does
senses.basis: God Passes By likens Bahá'u'lláh's Revelation to the sun throughout

senses.gloss: the unbroken succession of Manifestations — sunrise and sunset as a continuous, eternal process
senses.basis: progressive revelation stated as the sun's recurring cycle

instantiations: Its rays burst forth above Baghdad's horizon, signifying the revelation of Bahá'u'lláh.
the ascension of Bahá'u'lláh is the setting of the Sun of Truth
it suffered a momentary eclipse due to Bahá'u'lláh's banishment and withdrawal
Bahá'u'lláh, the world's greatest Luminary, experienced a momentary eclipse due to banishment
the Manifestation of God whose setting (ascension) causes immense grief among believers
fixtures._note: rising / eclipse / setting are PHASES of one metaphor keyed to events, not separate senses. Counting them as senses is the inflation this fixture exists to catch.

senses.gloss: the Persian Bayán — a specific work of the Báb
senses.basis: named as a distinct work in God Passes By

senses.gloss: the Arabic Bayán — a separate work from the Persian
the entire Revelation of the Báb taken as one
senses.basis: used for the Báb's Dispensation as a whole

senses.gloss: the followers of the Báb — 'the people of the Bayán'
senses.basis: 'people of the Bayán' denotes the Bábí community

senses.gloss: generic elucidation or utterance — NOT an entity at all
senses.basis: ordinary sense in the Íqán; the trap case for entity binding

fixtures._note: The canonical polysemy trap. A binder that resolves every 'Bayán' to one work is wrong five ways; one that resolves the generic 'utterance' sense to a WORK invents an entity.

senses.gloss: the Greater Covenant — God's eternal promise to send successive Manifestations
the Lesser Covenant — Bahá'u'lláh's appointment of 'Abdu'l-Bahá and the line of authority
senses.basis: The Dispensation of Bahá'u'lláh, the authoritative statement on succession

senses.gloss: the believer's own covenant of faithfulness and obedience
